# Ayato Studio

> AI-Native Systems Engineering Studio specialized in autonomous agents, Model Context Protocol (MCP), token-efficient AST compression, and completely offline (air-gapped) AI tools.

Ayato Studio builds lightweight, high-performance software based on the philosophy of "Engineering of Subtraction" — maximizing autonomy while minimizing server overhead and cloud token waste.

## Web MCP Server (Remote Model Context Protocol Endpoint)

AI agents (Cursor, Claude, Claude Code, ChatGPT) can connect directly to our remote MCP endpoint via JSON-RPC 2.0:
- Endpoint URL: `https://ayato-studio.ai/api/mcp`
- Protocol Version: `2024-11-05`
- Available Tools:
  - `search_ai_reports`: Search curated global AI research papers and intelligence reports.
  - `get_product_catalog`: Fetch specifications, pricing, and architectures of Ayato Studio products.
  - `get_technical_insights`: Retrieve in-depth technical guides and architecture decisions.

## Products & Tools

- [Transform_MovieToText](https://ayato-studio.ai/services/movie-to-text): 100% offline, air-gapped local AI meeting transcription and speaker diarization engine for Windows. No cloud data leakage (0 bytes sent). Powered by ONNX CAM++ and Non-Embedding SQLite FTS5 RAG.
- [ProjectCodeMap](https://ayato-studio.ai/services/project-code-map): AST-based codebase context compressor for AI-driven development (Cursor, Claude, ChatGPT). Compresses repository context by up to 85% into clean XML signatures (`uvx project-code-map`).
- [Ripen MCP](https://ayato-studio.ai/services/ripen): Knowledge graph & episodic long-term memory server for autonomous AI agents via Model Context Protocol (MCP).
- [LogicHive MCP](https://ayato-studio.ai/services/logichive): High-efficiency code snippet search and reuse engine for AI coding assistants.

## Technical Insights & Research

- [Why We Built 100% Offline Air-Gapped AI Transcription](https://ayato-studio.ai/insights/air-gapped-local-ai-transcription): Deep dive into local speaker diarization and why we replaced heavy vector embeddings with LLM query expansion + SQLite FTS5.
- [Compressing Codebase Context with tree-sitter AST](https://ayato-studio.ai/insights/llm-context-compression-with-ast): Preventing LLM hallucinations and reducing token costs by passing structured signatures instead of raw source code.
- [MCP Security Hardening & SQL Injection Mitigation](https://ayato-studio.ai/insights/mcp-sqlite-hardening): Practical security protocols for autonomous agent tool execution.
